ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Communicating messages and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Engaging parents or and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Soil environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Improving soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
